scope: GTA Online model eligibility, separate from player-installed upgrades. Exact model IDs are used.

bennys.label: Benny’s donor and custom conversion list

rockstar170.label: Rockstar Bureau Tech and PC Enhanced notes

hsw.workshop: Hao’s Special Works at the LS Car Meet
hsw.prerequisite: Use a supported game version and buy LS Car Meet membership. Pay for the HSW conversion and any HSW parts separately.

avenger.note: The jammer works while the Avenger is on autopilot. It is an alternative to the Stealth Module autopilot defense.

l352.note: GTABase labels this entry Drift Walton L35. The base model here is Walton L35 Stock (l352), confirmed with the jammer upgrade by GTACars. The original Walton L35 (l35) is a different model.

terbyte.note: This is Bureau Tech for an owned Terrorbyte. It does not grant the Imani remote control unit.

agency.label: Agency Vehicle Workshop
agency.requirements: Own an Agency with its Vehicle Workshop upgrade. Eligible road vehicles can also use the Vinewood Club Garage workshop with GTA+ where available.

hangar.label: Hangar Aircraft Workshop
hangar.requirements: Own a Hangar with its Aircraft Workshop. Convert eligible Pegasus aircraft into personal aircraft by storing them in your Hangar before modification.

avenger.label: Hangar Aircraft Workshop
avenger.requirements: Own an Avenger and a Hangar with its Workshop upgrade. Select an autopilot defense upgrade.

garment.label: Darnell Bros Garment Factory
garment.requirements: Own the Garment Factory and an owned Terrorbyte. Install the Bureau Tech jammer there.

researchNotes: 258 logical jammer entries map to exact catalogue IDs. The Avenger upgraded state is an alias of the same service aircraft.
31 Benny’s conversion outcomes. Tornado convertible and beater are verified additional donors. Mariachi and Rat Rod variants are excluded.
The Walton L35 Stock mapping corrects a source naming discrepancy using its per-model specification.
Imani full means jammer or remote control unit support. Armor, weapons and mines vary by vehicle and are not assumed for all 20.

baller3.note: Rockstar’s 1.70 notes list the Baller LE for a jammer upgrade. The current exact-model specification and the feature list omit it. Verify the upgrade menu in game before buying this model for its jammer.

caracara3.note: Rockstar’s 1.73 introduction groups the Caracara (Armored) with jammer eligible additions. The current exact-model specification and the feature list omit it. Verify the upgrade menu in game before relying on this upgrade.
